notable_absence.finding: Despite being one of the two billing-adjacent pages this batch's hypothesis specifically called out, support-pre-auth.md never mentions Support Plan, Service Plan, or any plan tier at all. Cluster recovery authorization is gated purely by capella-role (Organization Owner/Project Owner/Cluster Manager) and is 'enabled by default when you create a new cluster' - i.e. available on every tier including Free. This page therefore contributes nothing to resolving the Support-Plan-vs-Service-Plan wording question; the relevant evidence comes from billing.md and upgrade-account.md instead.

cross_component_finding: Cluster Manager is a role not present anywhere else in this batch or in the existing capella-role catalog - worth flagging to the reconciler as a possible sixth management-plane role alongside organization-owner/project-owner/project-data-writer/project-creator/organization-member.
